1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.g3 d5 5.ex.strategy: Puts the bishop on the long diagonal, the point of the g3 set-up, behind the f3 knight, and prepares castling. White accepts a quiet game and pressure on the centre and the queenside from a distance, instead of occupying it.

Trades off White's knight on c3. Either recapture doubles White's c-pawns, though it opens the b-file or the d-file for White. Black simplifies and eases the game, at the price of letting the g2 bishop work freely.
